answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 39195 Country: India Title: Please give any good wazifah or dua for reciting, as my khala is not getting any good marriage proposal Question: Please give any good wazifah or dua for reciting, as my khala is not getting any good marriage proposal. She is 27 years old very good looking and very fair but then too she is not getting any proposal. We all are very much worried. Please give any good wazifah or amal. Answer ID: 39195 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1153/967/B=1433) Keep on reciting Ya Latif Ya Latif (یا لطیف یا لطیف) extensively and ask your khala to recite Ya Jame Ya Jame (يا جامع يا جامع). There is no time or number fixed for it, whenever and as much time she wants she may recite it. Also durood should be added 3-3 times before and after. In-shaAllah, after reciting it soon she will receive good proposals. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
